items.title: Association Between Systemic Fluoroquinolones and Risk of Peripheral Neuropathy.
items.abstract: Fluoroquinolone use has been associated with peripheral neuropathy in case reports, but there have been few noninterventional studies validating this association, and causality is unclear. The aim of this study was to estimate the association between systemic fluoroquinolone prescription and incident peripheral neuropathy relative to a comparator class of antibiotics, cephalosporins, using multiple databases to increase precision and assess the robustness of the results. Cohort studies were conducted using data from 2 databases of UK electronic primary care records, Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum and GOLD, from April 1, 1997, to December 31, 2019. Among adults (age ≥18 years) without diabetes mellitus or previously recorded peripheral neuropathy prescribed systemic fluoroquinolones or cephalosporins, hazard ratios were estimated between fluoroquinolone prescription and incident peripheral neuropathy within 60 days of prescription using stabilized inverse probability of treatment weighted Cox regression. Hazard ratios were similarly estimated for a positive control outcome of incident tendon rupture within 60 days of prescription. Risk differences for peripheral neuropathy were estimated using a weighted Aalen-Johansen estimator. Estimates were pooled across databases using fixed-effects meta-analysis. In total, 2,933,982 individuals prescribed fluoroquinolones or cephalosporins in Aurum (63.7% [n = 1,868,793] female; median age 49.5 years [interquartile range (IQR) 34.1-67.5]) and 995,457 in GOLD (63.5% [n = 632,033] female, median age 51.5 years [IQR 35.6-68.0]) were included. Of these individuals, at first treatment episode, 1,002,004 (34.2%) in Aurum and 381,734 (38.3%) in GOLD were prescribed fluoroquinolones. The estimated association between fluoroquinolones and peripheral neuropathy was close to the null at first treatment episode (pooled adjusted hazard ratio [aHR] 0.96, 95% CI 0.77-1.20) and over all treatment episodes (pooled aHR 1.05, 95% CI 0.92-1.20). Hazard ratios were elevated for a positive control outcome of tendon rupture at first treatment episode (pooled aHR 1.98, 95% CI 1.55-2.53) and over all treatment episodes (1.76, 95% CI 1.52-2.04). Findings were not indicative of a substantive difference in risk of peripheral neuropathy between those prescribed fluoroquinolones and cephalosporins. Potential residual confounding is a study limitation. Study results provide some reassurance to clinicians regarding risk of peripheral neuropathy with fluoroquinolones relative to a comparator antibiotic.
items.summary_ja:
背景：フルオロキノロン系抗生物質の使用は症例報告で末梢神経障害と関連が指摘されているが、非介入研究は少なく因果関係は不明である。  
方法：英国の2つの電子診療記録データベース（CPRD AurumおよびGOLD）を用い、糖尿病や既往の末梢神経障害のない成人に対し、フルオロキノロン系とセフェム系抗生物質処方後60日以内の新規末梢神経障害発症リスクをコックス回帰モデルで比較した。腱断裂を陽性対照アウトカムとして評価し、結果は固定効果メタ解析で統合した。  
結果：計約390万人の患者のうち、約34～38％がフルオロキノロン系を処方された。初回および全治療期間での末梢神経障害リスクは両群で差がなく（調整ハザード比0.96～1.05）、一方で腱断裂リスクはフルオロキノロン群で有意に高かった（1.76～1.98）。  
結論：フルオロキノロン系抗生物質はセフェム系と比較して末梢神経障害リスクの増加を示さず、臨床的には一定の安全性が示唆される。ただし残存交絡の可能性はある。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、全身性フルオロキノロン系抗生物質の使用と末梢神経障害発症リスクの関連を、セフェム系抗生物質と比較して検証した。英国の2つの大規模電子カルテデータベースを用いたコホート研究で、約390万人の成人を対象に解析した結果、フルオロキノロン使用による末梢神経障害リスクの増加は認められなかった（調整ハザード比約1.0）。一方、腱断裂のリスクは有意に上昇しており、末梢神経障害リスクに関しては一定の安全性が示唆された。

items.title: Differential Trajectories of Brain Atrophy in Multiple Sclerosis, MOGAD, and AQP4 + NMOSD: The Role of Disease Activity in MOGAD.
items.abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS), myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody-associated disease (MOGAD), and aquaporin-4 antibody-positive neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (AQP4 + NMOSD) are inflammatory demyelinating disorders with distinct mechanisms of tissue injury. MS is characterized by diffuse neurodegeneration, whereas damage in antibody-mediated diseases is considered attack related. In MOGAD, the relationship between disease activity and brain atrophy remains unclear. We aimed to compare longitudinal trajectories of global and regional brain atrophy across MS, MOGAD, and AQP4 + NMOSD and investigate whether atrophy in MOGAD is associated with disease course and lesion dynamics. In this retrospective multicenter Magnetic Resonance Imaging in Multiple Sclerosis (MAGNIMS) study, patients fulfilling the following criteria were enrolled: (1) age 18 years or older, (2) MS/MOGAD/AQP4 + NMOSD diagnosis, (3) ≥2 same-scanner brain MRIs ≥6 months apart and ≥3 months postattack, (4) concurrent Expanded Disability Status Scale, and (5) disease course information. White matter lesions were segmented using the Lesion Segmentation Toolbox. Longitudinal brain volumes were quantified on lesion-filled T1-weighted images using Sequence Adaptive Multimodal SEGmentation (SAMSEG) with a within-subject template approach. In MOGAD, lesion dynamics were classified as stable/new lesions/lesion resolution. Linear mixed-effects models adjusted for age, sex, baseline volume, and center estimated atrophy rates. Overall, 489 participants from 15 centers were included (98 MS [mean age 39.79 years, 68.37% female], 72 MOGAD [42.14 years, 66.67%], 41 AQP4 + NMOSD [51.25 years, 87.80%], and 278 healthy controls [42.94 years, 61.87%]). The mean follow-up was MS: 2.44 ± 1.55 years, MOGAD: 2.57 ± 1.85, and AQP4 + NMOSD: 3.22 ± 2.42. Compared with controls, MS showed accelerated global brain atrophy (β = -2.027 cm Each inflammatory demyelinating disease exhibits a characteristic pattern of brain atrophy. In MOGAD, neuroaxonal loss seems associated with inflammatory activity and lesion accrual, supporting an event-driven pattern of tissue injury rather than diffuse neurodegeneration. Limitations include small NMOSD sample, heterogeneous follow-up, and potential scanner-related variability.
items.summary_ja:
背景：多発性硬化症（MS）、ミエリンオリゴデンドロサイト糖タンパク抗体関連疾患（MOGAD）、およびアクアポリン4抗体陽性視神経脊髄炎スペクトラム障害（AQP4+ NMOSD）は、それぞれ異なる組織損傷機序を持つ炎症性脱髄疾患である。MSは広範な神経変性を特徴とする一方、抗体介在性疾患では病変の活動に伴う損傷が主とされるが、MOGADにおける脳萎縮と疾患活動性の関係は不明であった。  

方法：MAGNIMS多施設共同研究にて、MS、MOGAD、AQP4+ NMOSD患者計211名と278名の健常対照を対象に、同一MRI装置で6か月以上間隔を空けた2回以上の脳MRIを用い、Lesion Segmentation ToolboxとSAMSEG法で白質病変と脳体積を定量。MOGADの病変動態は安定、新規、消失に分類し、線形混合効果モデルで萎縮速度を推定した。  

結果：MSは健常者に比べ全脳萎縮が有意に加速。MOGADでは病変の増加や炎症活動に伴い神経軸索損失が進行し、拡散的な神経変性ではなく発作に伴う局所的損傷パターンを示した。AQP4+ NMOSDはサンプル数が少なく解析に制限があった。  

結論：各疾患は特徴的な脳萎縮パターンを示し、MOGADの脳萎縮は炎症活動と病変動態に強く関連することから、イベント駆動型の組織損傷機序が示唆された。研究の限界として、NMOSDの症例数の少なさや追跡期間のばらつき、装置間差異の影響が挙げられる。
items.summary_short_ja: 多発性硬化症（MS）、MOG抗体関連疾患（MOGAD）、およびAQP4抗体陽性視神経脊髄炎スペクトラム障害（AQP4+NMOSD）は、それぞれ異なる脳萎縮の進行パターンを示す。特にMOGADでは、脳萎縮が炎症活動や新旧病変の動態と関連し、拡散的な神経変性ではなく発作に伴う組織障害が主因と示唆された。本研究は多施設MRIデータを用い、これら疾患の萎縮速度と病態の違いを比較した。

items.title: Child Neurology: Neonatal Management of Tyrosine Hydroxylase Deficiency: How Early Is Early Enough?
items.abstract: Tyrosine hydroxylase deficiency is a rare, treatable, autosomal recessive disorder of monoamine neurotransmitter biosynthesis that typically presents in infancy or early childhood. Despite potential benefits of presymptomatic treatment with levodopa/carbidopa, prenatal or neonatal diagnosis remains extremely rare. We report 2 preterm neonates from unrelated families, both with known family history of tyrosine hydroxylase deficiency. After early diagnosis, levodopa/carbidopa therapy was initiated during the neonatal period. This proactive approach proved feasible and well tolerated, leading to early normalization of subtle motor abnormalities. These cases highlight the importance of early genetic diagnosis of this rare condition and the feasibility of levodopa/carbidopa treatment in neonates.
items.summary_ja:
背景：チロシンヒドロキシラーゼ欠損症は、モノアミン神経伝達物質の合成異常によるまれな常染色体劣性遺伝疾患であり、通常は乳児期や幼児期に発症する。レボドパ/カルビドパによる無症状期の治療が有益とされるが、出生前や新生児期の診断例は非常に少ない。  
方法：チロシンヒドロキシラーゼ欠損症の家族歴がある2組の未熟児新生児を対象に、早期遺伝子診断を行い、新生児期にレボドパ/カルビドパ療法を開始した。  
結果：早期治療は実施可能で副作用も少なく、微細な運動異常の早期正常化が認められた。  
結論：本報告は、この希少疾患の早期遺伝子診断の重要性と、新生児期におけるレボドパ/カルビドパ治療の有用性および安全性を示している。
items.summary_short_ja: チロシンヒドロキシラーゼ欠損症は、乳児期に発症するまれな遺伝性神経伝達物質合成障害である。家族歴のある早産新生児2例に対し、新生児期に早期診断を行いレボドパ/カルビドパ療法を開始したところ、運動異常の早期正常化が認められた。本報告は、早期遺伝子診断の重要性と新生児期からの治療の有効性を示している。

items.title: Recanalization After Acute Cervical Artery Dissection: A Multicenter International Study.
items.abstract: The rates and factors associated with complete recanalization after cervical artery dissection (CeAD) have not been comprehensively quantified in large cohorts. We sought to determine the 6-month rate of complete recanalization in CeAD, clinical and imaging factors associated with recanalization, and risk of recurrent ischemic stroke based on recanalization status. This was a planned subanalysis of the Antithrombotic Treatment for Stroke Prevention in Cervical Artery Dissection study, a multicenter retrospective cohort including patients with imaging-confirmed CeAD diagnosed between January 2015 and June 2022 at 63 sites worldwide. For this analysis, we included 1,095 patients with single-vessel CeAD causing stenosis at presentation who had available follow-up vascular imaging at 6 months after CeAD. The primary outcome was complete recanalization within 6 months after CeAD. Clinical and imaging variables, as well as recurrent stroke, were compared between patients with and those without complete recanalization. Factors independently associated with complete recanalization were identified using multivariable logistic regression. Time to complete recanalization was analyzed using an accelerated failure time Weibull model. Among 1,095 included patients (median age 45 years; 46.7% female), 634 (57.9%) achieved complete recanalization by 6 months. In multivariable analysis, each additional year of age was associated with lower odds of complete recanalization (odds ratio [OR] 0.97 per year; 95% CI 0.96-0.98;  Almost 60% of patients with CeAD achieved complete vessel recanalization by 6 months. Older age, diabetes, smoking, and complete occlusion at presentation were independently associated with incomplete recanalization. Further study is required to determine whether these findings may help guide tailored imaging surveillance and secondary prevention strategies.
items.summary_ja: 背景：頸部動脈解離（CeAD）後の完全再開通率や関連因子は大規模コホートで十分に検証されていない。方法：2015年1月から2022年6月までに63施設で画像診断されたCeAD患者1,095例（単一血管の狭窄例）を対象に、6か月後の血管画像フォローアップを行い、完全再開通率と臨床・画像因子、再発虚血性脳卒中リスクを比較検討した。多変量ロジスティック回帰で再開通に独立して関連する因子を解析し、再開通までの時間は加速失敗時間モデルで評価した。結果：中央値45歳、女性46.7%の患者のうち、57.9%が6か月以内に完全再開通を達成。年齢増加（OR 0.97/年）、糖尿病、喫煙、初診時の完全閉塞が不完全再開通と独立して関連した。結論：CeAD患者の約60%が6か月で完全再開通するが、高齢、糖尿病、喫煙、完全閉塞は再開通不良のリスク因子である。これらの知見は個別化した画像監視や二次予防戦略の指針となる可能性があり、さらなる研究が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 急性頸部動脈解離（CeAD）患者1,095例を対象に6カ月後の完全再開通率を調査した結果、約58％が完全再開通を達成した。年齢上昇、糖尿病、喫煙、完全閉塞の初期所見が再開通不全の独立した因子であった。これらの知見は、個別化された画像監視や二次予防戦略の検討に役立つ可能性がある。

items.title: Idiopathic Normal Pressure Hydrocephalus: A Review.
items.abstract: Idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus (iNPH) is a progressive neurological disorder characterized by cerebral ventricular enlargement that is typically associated with gait impairment and often urinary dysfunction and cognitive decline in older adults. iNPH prevalence is approximately 1% to 4% among individuals 65 years and older and 6% to 8% among those 80 years and older. iNPH is a multifactorial disorder involving interactions among cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) circulation, vascular dysfunction, and white matter injury. Unlike secondary NPH, iNPH occurs without a known antecedent event such as subarachnoid hemorrhage. Gait disturbance, including a broad-based, slow, shuffling gait and impaired turning, occurs in 85% to 95% of patients with iNPH and is often the earliest symptom. Urinary dysfunction occurs in approximately 75% to 90% of patients with iNPH and commonly includes urgency, nocturia, urge incontinence, or leakage. Cognitive impairment is reported in 60% to 80% of patients with iNPH, predominantly involving impaired attention, processing speed, working memory, verbal fluency, and cognitive flexibility. iNPH is diagnosed primarily based on characteristic clinical findings and neuroimaging (typically brain magnetic resonance imaging) demonstrating cerebral ventricular and subarachnoid space enlargement. Although necessary for diagnosis, these neuroimaging findings are not reliably associated with response to treatment. Early diagnosis of NPH is important because shorter symptom duration and less advanced disease are associated with more favorable outcomes. Patients being evaluated for iNPH should undergo large-volume lumbar puncture with removal of 30 to 50 mL of CSF to confirm the diagnosis and predict shunt responsiveness, measured as improvement in objective gait measures starting within hours after drainage. Extended lumbar drainage with removal of 200 to 300 mL of CSF over several days in an inpatient setting provides higher prognostic accuracy, and may be performed in patients with high clinical suspicion and a negative or equivocal clinical response to lumbar puncture. Treatment for iNPH is CSF diversion with shunt placement, most commonly performed with ventriculoperitoneal shunts, although ventriculoatrial and lumboperitoneal shunts may have similar efficacy. After shunting, approximately 75% to 80% of patients have gait velocity improvement; cognitive and urinary improvements occur in approximately 50% to 70%. Complications of shunts include overdrainage and underdrainage (10%-30%), presenting as postural headaches and subdural collections, and recurrence or worsening of iNPH symptoms, shunt malfunction (10%-20%), and shunt infections (<1%-2%). iNPH affects approximately 1% to 4% of adults 65 years and older and is associated with gait impairment, cognitive decline, and urinary dysfunction. Symptoms improve in approximately 70% to 90% of patients with iNPH who undergo shunt surgery.
items.summary_ja:
背景：特発性正常圧水頭症（iNPH）は、高齢者に多く見られる進行性の神経疾患で、脳室拡大を特徴とし、歩行障害、排尿障害、認知機能低下を伴う。65歳以上の約1～4％、80歳以上では6～8％の有病率がある。iNPHは脳脊髄液循環、血管機能障害、白質損傷が複合的に関与し、二次性NPHとは異なり明確な先行疾患がない。  
方法：診断は臨床症状と脳MRIによる脳室・くも膜下腔拡大の確認で行い、診断補助として大容量腰椎穿刺（30～50mLの髄液除去）や数日間の持続的腰椎ドレナージ（200～300mL除去）を用いてシャント手術の効果予測を行う。  
結果：シャント手術後、歩行速度は約75～80％の患者で改善し、認知機能や排尿機能も約50～70％で改善が見られる。合併症として過排液・排液不足、シャント機能不全、感染などが報告されている。  
結論：iNPHは高齢者の歩行障害や認知・排尿障害の重要な原因であり、早期診断とシャント手術による治療が有効で、多くの患者で症状改善が期待できる。
items.summary_short_ja: 特発性正常圧水頭症（iNPH）は、高齢者に多くみられ、脳室拡大に伴う歩行障害、尿失禁、認知機能低下を特徴とする進行性神経疾患である。診断は臨床所見とMRIによる脳室拡大で行い、腰椎穿刺による髄液除去で治療効果を予測する。治療はシャント手術が主で、約70～90％の患者で症状改善が期待できるが、過排液や感染などの合併症もある。
